notes.title: Something in the Water Playtest 0.1.4
notes.notes: [p]So you might have noticed a small update to Something in the Water. This is not the previously planned AI test just yet, but rather a focused polish patch for the existing build.[/p][p][b]Here's a quick list of the changes in 0.1.4:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added game name to title screen[/p][/*][*][p]Player now starts with full health[/p][/*][*][p]Teleporters replaced by locked doors (and keys!)[/p][/*][*][p]Most floating tutorial text replaced with on-screen prompts[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new locked door/key section to the level[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the geo for the shooting range and medical room[/p][/*][*][p]Added reactive crosshair to reflect weapon accuracy[/p][/*][*][p]Added low ammo audio feedback on Nailgun[/p][/*][*][p]Added surface impact sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Added surface impact VFX[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased minimum accuracy whilst moving[/p][/*][*][p]Started adding VFX for surface damage[/p][/*][*][p]Placeholder damage decals from Nailgun and Knife impacts[/p][/*][*][p]Added an outline to pickups (I'm not 100% on this aesthetically)[/p][/*][*][p]Minor improvements to Nailgun audio[/p][/*][*][p]Minor improvements to Knife audio[/p][/*][*][p]Removed zoom (and vignette) when readying the knife[/p][/*][*][p]Improved frame pacing[/p][/*][*][p]Set visual default to "Crunchy"[/p][/*][*][p]Other small tweaks and polish[/p][/*][/list][h3]So where's the AI test?[/h3][p]It's still coming! I've got some basic melee enemies in, but I'm aiming to get ranged enemies in place before opening up another round of feedback. Thanks again for spending time to fill out the survey - your responses have been super helpful![/p][p]As always, you'll get a notification here when a new build is available. I hope you enjoy this small patch in the meantime, and thanks for playing and for helping make Something in the Water better![/p][p][/p][p]- [i]Sean Noonan[/i][/p]

notes.title: First Prototype is now live!
notes.notes:
[p]So that's the first prototype live!

Thanks again to everyone who tried this first build of Something in the Water. I’ve reviewed all of the feedback, and it’s already helping shape the next steps.

I’m working on a new test build right now, featuring early combat systems and some AI. It should be ready before the end of the month.

You’ll get a notification here when the new build is available. Until then, thanks for playing and for helping make the game better![/p][p][/p][p]- [i]Sean Noonan[/i][/p]
